segments.name: Software solutions
segments.description: Provides customized software solutions, cloud-based SaaS platforms and white-label software development services to SMBs in Hong Kong.
segments.evidence: Based on management's assessment, the Company has determined that it has only one operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for customized software solutions, white label software and cloud-based SaaS subscriptions.
revenueModel.evidence: Accounts receivable mainly represent amounts due from customers for provision of customized software solutions and cloud-based SaaS services from subscription which are recorded net of allowance for the Company's expected credit losses.
